mood_why: Milestone's own words lead with speed and follow-through ("same-day", "fully stocked trucks", "peace of mind") and their photographs show real trucks, technicians and a completed panel job, not a styled studio set -- the material earns a page that reads as capable and immediate, not polished-generic.
signature_why: Milestone's strongest real asset is five named-author Google reviews (Jeff Willie, Mandana Shahbazi, Farrah Carlton, Brett Conway, James Kerr) behind a real 4.9-star, 6,203-review count -- one review set at full display size does more to earn a stranger's trust than a stat band or an icon grid ever could for someone deciding who to let into their home.
